title: Silky Hummus
description: Ultra-smooth hummus made from canned chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic, whipped with ice water until light and creamy.

image.alt: A swirl of hummus with olive oil and paprika, with pita wedges

steps.text: Blend the lemon juice, garlic and salt in the food processor, then let them sit for {time 5 min} to mellow the garlic.
Add the tahini and blend until thick and creamy. With the machine running, add the ice water a spoonful at a time until pale and smooth.
Add the chickpeas and cumin and blend for a full {time 3 min}, scraping down once, until very smooth. Add more ice water if it’s too thick.
Spread in a shallow bowl, make a swirl with the back of a spoon, drizzle with oil and dust with paprika.

notes: Blending the tahini with lemon and water first, before the chickpeas, is what makes it so smooth.
